title: Entropy Stable Element-Local Continuous-Discontinuous Residual Correction Summation-By-Parts Discretization
summary: Residual correction provides an efficient alternative to two-point volume flux differencing for enforcing entropy stability in high-order discretizations of hyperbolic partial differential equations. We develop an element-local residual-correction summation-by-parts (SBP) method that combines continuous-SBP (C-SBP) and discontinuous-SBP (D-SBP) coupling on conforming meshes. The construction retains continuous assembly without simultaneous approximation terms (SATs) wherever suitable, restricts SATs to selected discontinuous facets, and permits the coupling to change in time as a foundation…
